proof_contract.both_partitions: each side must consist of 2-4 nondegenerate Q25 cells, all covered by a valid cohesive patch ID, with exact oriented edge cancellation, exact parent-boundary tiling, and no positive-area pair overlap
proof_contract.parent_sweep: the two physical parent triangles must match by one exact vertex permutation at both linear-sweep endpoints; nonfinite, duplicate, degenerate, or unmatched geometry declines the skip
proof_contract.patch_correspondence: each side must have equal cell count; every left cell must match exactly one right cell with the same coveredPatchIndex and the same computed 3D cell-vertex start/end positions under permutation; these positions are computed with the same FP32 barycentric mapping used by CCD
proof_contract.fallthrough: any failed predicate falls through to the existing complement/contact CCD path without changing its tolerances or histories

The skip only handles coincident parent triangles with identical linear vertex trajectories, exact full coverage, and exact matching patch-cell trajectories/IDs. Relative translation, opening, shear, differential parent motion, partial covers, unequal patch tessellations, non-Q25 cells, and FP32 world-point mismatches retain the existing CCD path.
The exact Q25 partition helper is bounded to four cells and may decline valid larger partitions; this is a conservative fallback, not a capacity expansion.
The same-point/initial-witness suppression from the older 320 proposal is not part of this patch and remains unsafe/unapplied.
